svg.title: HyperWeave Banner — Cherenkov Protocol Smooth Mutation
svg.desc: HyperWeave repository banner mutated with Cherenkov Protocol aesthetic DNA: ultra-smooth liquid caustic flow without discrete noise stepping, refined geometric sigil without orbital nodes, clean hero layout, and ionized pearl-chrome typography.

hw:reasoning.hw:intent: Eliminate all stepped/jagged noise artifacts to create an ultra-smooth, living fluid caustic drift; distill the geometric sigil by stripping peripheral orbital satellites; remove secondary telemetry headers for an uncluttered hero presentation.
hw:reasoning.hw:approach: 1. Fluid Caustic Motion: Replaced frequency modulation (which caused grid-tearing and jerky jumps) with stable Perlin noise surfaces filtered through higher Gaussian diffusion (stdDeviation 14/11). Applied harmonic sinusoidal key-spline orbits to three decorrelated point lights (34s, 42s, and 55s cycles) for continuous, non-reversing fluid caustic flow. 2. Sigil Purification: Stripped all floating orbital satellite circles and outer coordinate markers, preserving purely the primary hexagonal contour and breathing central lens core. 3. Compositional Clarity: Removed top-right telemetry badges and text to establish absolute focus on the HyperWeave lockup and subtitle hierarchy.
hw:reasoning.hw:tradeoffs: Fixed baseFrequency to a static seed calculation to prevent Perlin recompilation shuddering while shifting all kinetic energy to smooth specular lighting vectors.
hw:reasoning.hw:spatial-notes: 1200x300 canvas, panel rect 16,16 1168x268 rx16. Distilled sigil center (130,134) scale 0.82. Wordmark anchored at x176.6, y-552.5 scale 1.25 (glyph 'H' starts at x225). Subtitle flush left at x225, y214.

svg.text: The artifact layer for agent-human representations
